nodes.description: Public mapping tracking token balances of each address; written without SafeMath in transferFrom and batchSend.
Public nested mapping of owner-spender allowances; decremented unchecked in transferFrom.
Private per-address sale counter incremented on every transferFrom, used by condition().
Private whitelist mapping; addresses set true by _mints bypass the sale conditions in ensure().
Minimum sale value threshold set by init() and enforced in condition().
Maximum sale value threshold set by init() and enforced in condition().
Maximum number of sales per address, set by init() and enforced in condition().
Privileged trade address whitelisted in ensure(); settable only by owner via setTradeAddress().
Constant 18 decimals used for scaling amounts in init(), _mints() and the constructor.
Total token supply assigned in the constructor.
Contract owner address; gate for delegate(), _mints(), init(), batchSend() and setTradeAddress().
Constant Uniswap router address whitelisted in ensure().
Public payable transfer that delegates to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Internal view guard that whitelists owner, UNI pair, tradeAddress and canSale addresses, else calls condition().
Public payable transferFrom performing unchecked balance and allowance arithmetic after ensure().
Public payable approve writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value.
Internal view enforcing sale count, minimum and maximum sale thresholds.
Owner-only function performing an arbitrary delegatecall to attacker-controlled address and data.
Privileged function that sets balances and whitelists an address via canSale.
Owner-only initializer of sale thresholds _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum.
Owner-only batch transfer using unchecked multiplication and subtraction of balances.
Owner-only setter for the whitelisted tradeAddress.
Internal pure Uniswap pair address computation via keccak256 of sorted tokens.
Payable constructor assigning name, symbol, supply, owner and an unlimited UNI allowance.
External caller address used for owner checks, allowance checks and transfer authorization.
Low-level delegatecall with arbitrary target and calldata, allowing storage takeover.
Unchecked subtraction balanceOf[_from] -= _value in transferFrom without SafeMath.
Unchecked subtraction allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value in transferFrom.
Unchecked addition balanceOf[_to] += _value in transferFrom.
Unchecked multiplication uint total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend.
Unchecked subtraction balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total in batchSend.
Arbitrary balance assignment balanceOf[spender] = addedValue*(10**decimals) in _mints.
Unchecked multiplication token*(10**uint256(decimals)) assigned to _minSale in init.
Unchecked multiplication maxToken*(10**uint256(decimals)) assigned to _maxSale in init.
